name: Executioner
description: Your demons deal bonus damage to enemies below 30% HP.

name: Glass Fang
description: Your demons deal more damage but have less health.

name: Hunger
description: When an ally dies, surviving demons gain attack speed for the battle.

name: Living Carapace
description: Your demons gradually regenerate health during battle.

name: Spite Armor
description: Enemies that directly damage your demons take reflected damage.

name: Martyr Skin
description: When a demon dies, surviving allies heal.

name: Hunter's Eye
description: Your demons hunt the lowest-HP enemy and deal extra damage to it.

name: Crown of Rage
description: Your highest-damage demon gains attack speed.

name: Blindfold
description: Your demons choose random enemy targets but deal significantly more damage.

name: Shepherd's Skull
description: Tank demons take less damage while another ally remains alive.

name: Ring of the Pack
description: Your team gains damage for each different demon role represented.

name: Last One
description: The final surviving demon becomes significantly stronger.

name: Blood Circle
description: Healing also grants the healed demon a temporary damage increase.

name: Rot Ring
description: Your poison lasts longer but deals less damage per tick.

name: Empty Ring
description: Your team gains damage for each unused formation slot.

name: Mirror Ring
description: Your strongest demon shares part of its stats with your weakest demon.

name: Ring of Nine
description: A full nine-demon team gains damage, health, and speed.

name: Black Shield
description: Your demons begin combat with a temporary shield.

name: Soul Jar
description: The first demon to die resurrects once.

name: Demon Bell
description: Enemies start combat slowed for a short time.

name: Ash Idol
description: Fire demons deal much more damage, but their attacks scorch allies.

name: Rotten Heart
description: Poison applied by your demons reduces healing received by the victim.

name: Broken Hourglass
description: Your demons gain a strong temporary speed bonus at battle start.

name: Sacrificial Idol
description: Your weakest demon starts at 50% HP and every other demon gains damage.

name: War Ring
description: Type 1 demons gain damage and attack speed.

name: Void Ring
description: Type 2 demons gain damage and attack speed.

name: Rot Ring
description: Type 3 demons gain damage and attack speed.

name: Fire Ring
description: Type 4 demons gain damage and attack speed.

name: Thorn Ring
description: Type 5 demons gain damage and attack speed.

name: Mercy Ring
description: Type 6 demons gain damage and attack speed.

name: Shadow Ring
description: Type 7 demons gain damage and attack speed.

name: Bone Ring
description: Type 8 demons gain damage and attack speed.

name: Titan Ring
description: Type 9 demons gain damage and attack speed.

name: Rift Ring
description: Type 10 demons gain damage and attack speed.

name: Storm Ring
description: Type 11 demons gain damage and attack speed.
